messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] STOP ERROR in fix_BioGeoBEARS_params_minmax(): One of the inputs must be non-NULL.
parts:
Hi -- this error message is only in this function:

fix_BioGeoBEARS_params_minmax(BioGeoBEARS_run_object=NULL, BioGeoBEARS_model_object=NULL, params_table=NULL)

...which suggests that you have fix_BioGeoBEARS_params_minmax() somewhere in your script.  For that function to work, you have to give it one of BioGeoBEARS_run_object, BioGeoBEARS_model_object, params_table. 

But you only need to run fix_BioGeoBEARS_params_minmax() if you want to automate making sure that the starting parameters are inside your min/max limits for the parameters.  E.g., imagine that the BAYAREALIKE inference of e was 0.000000000001, but the min for BAYAREALIKE+J was e=0.000001, and the script happened to automatically input the BAYAREALIKE e in as the starting e for BAYAREALIKE+J. This would cause an error, but fix_BioGeoBEARS_params_minmax would fix it.

But this is all inside baseball and its hard to say without knowing whats in your script.

None of this has much to do with BSM success, except that BSM does run fix_BioGeoBEARS_params_minmax once as a check I think -- if you tried to run BSM but failed to actually give BSM the necessary BioGeoBEARS_run_object from the ML analysis, that could cause the issue maybe.

Cheers!
Nick
